criteria.method: total_gib <= capacity_gib - reserved_gib for the target hardware
apply license_policy.json to license_id and publisher_verified
sha256 of the downloaded file equals the pinned value
compare predicted_days with expected_days on local_eval_dev.jsonl
json parse of raw must equal {'days': int} for every dev case
dispatcher probe with a foreign tenant must be rejected
client-clock wall time per request, linear-interpolation P95
sum completion_tokens divided by sum elapsed_s

decision_rule: admit only if every stage1 criterion passes and every stage2 criterion meets its threshold
note: thresholds are fixed on dev before any test run; test split is never used to set them
